# LLM API Pricing Calculator

> Compare the monthly dollar cost of calling different LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, or a custom provider) for your own workload -- modelling fresh input, cached input, and output tokens separately, since cached tokens are billed far below fresh input and usually dominate agentic workloads. Free, private, no signup.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
